senses.gloss: to be smooth, to be viscous. V. חָלָק.
(denom. of חֵלֶק) to assign, allot.—ח׳ כבוד to honor, pay regards.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 19b">Ber. 19ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>כל מקום … אין חוֹלְקִין וכ׳</he> wherever the desecration of the name of the Lord is threatened, no regards must be paid to a teacher.
<cite ref="Zevachim 102a:1">Zeb. 102ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (denom. of חֵלֶק) to divide (by lot); to part; to take a share.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:5">Peah III, 5</cite> <he>האחין שחָלְקוּ</he> brothers who divided an estate.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:1">B. Mets. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>יַחֲלוֹקוּ</he> they shall divide the object (equally).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 12:1">Zeb. XII, 1</cite> <he>אינן חוֹלְקִין וכ׳</he> take no share &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 65a:3">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>אם חוֹלֵק את רגליו וכ׳</he> if the birds parts its toes (on the rope) so that there be two on each side &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:10">Y. Sabb. VII, 9ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>דבר … אינו חולק</he> if a prohibition (included in a law) is specified again for a purpose, it does not intimate a division (that each single act of the class must be atoned for singly, v. <cite ref="E00048"><he>הַבְעָרָה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:1">Tosef. Dem. VI, 1</cite> <he>חוֹלְקָן</he> he divides the fruits with the landlord. [<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>החולק</he>, read: <he>החוֹכֵר</he>.] Y. ib. VI, beg. 25ᵃ <he>מישראל חולק</he> if the property is farmed from an Israelite, he divides the produces (before separating T’rumah); a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 15:2:3">Y. Sabb. XV, beg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>מה חוֹלְקִין על וכ׳</he> how is it? do they differ with &c.?—

Ber. 27ᵇ החולק על ישיבתו וכ׳ וכ׳; Snh. 110ᵃ הח׳ על רבו (Ar. הנֶחְלַק, Nif.) he who opposes (the school of) his teacher. Ber. l. c. כלום יש אדם חוֹלֵק בדבר זה is there any one here differing from this opinion?; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. חָלוּק, pl. חֲלוּקִים, חֲלוּקִין divided, interrupted; disputed; of different opinion.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 8:2">Mikv. VIII, 2</cite> <he>מים ח׳</he> interrupted flow of urin.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 176a:15">B. Bath. 176ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ היה ר׳ וכ׳</he> R. … differed &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:10">Ib. IX, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 158b">158ᵇ</cite>) <he>על החֲלוּקִין ואתה בא לחַלֵּק עלינו וכ׳ …</he> we grieve over the divided opinions, and you come to assert a division for us on things on which they (the schools of Shammai and Hillel) agree?; (<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:3">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>לַחֲלוֹק</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:10:6">Y. Keth. I, end, 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ על אביו</he> differs with his father; a. fr.—Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 6, a. e. <he>ארבעה חֲלוּקֵי כפרה</he> there are four persons under different categories as to atonement.
<cite ref="Arakhin 10b:37">Arakh. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>דחֲלוּקָה בקרבנותיה</he> which differs (from other days) as regards sacrifices.
<cite ref="Arakhin 10b:37">Ib.</cite> <he>חֲלוּקִין וכ׳</he> the numbers of sacrifices are different each day.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 27:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXVII</cite> (ref. to <he>אחלק</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:9">Ex. XV, 9</cite>) <he>אֵיחָלֵק</he> I shall be divided (plundered).
<cite ref="Chagigah 16b:11">Ḥag. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>נֶחְלְקוּ בה וכ׳</he> the great men of the age differ about it.
<cite ref="Berakhot 27b">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:1">Keth. XIII, 1</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to smoothen, make even, level; to improve the appearance.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:8">Maasr. I, 8</cite> <he>משיַחֲלִיקֶנּוּ</he> from the moment that he smoothens the cake of figs (by rubbing it with figs or grapes).
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:8">Ib.</cite> <he>המַחֲלִיק בענבים</he> if one uses grapes for smoothening.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:4">Shebi. IV, 4</cite> <he>במַחֲלִיק</he> when one levels a field (by taking out plants); expl.
ib. המח׳ ג׳ זה בצד זה levelling means taking out (at least) three plants next to each other, contrad. to המדל, taking out one or two plants.—
Peah III, 3, v. אֶחָד; a. e.—Trnsf. to close a tune softly (piano).

Arakh. II, 3 (10ᵃ) ולא היה מַחֲלִיק אלא … מפני שהוא מחליק יפה (Talm. ed. ולא היה מְחַלֵּק מחליק וכ׳ …) none but a flute solo was used for closing a tune, because it makes a pleasant finale.—3) to glide, slip.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 10:14">Erub. X, 14</cite> <he>בשביל שלא יַחֲלִיקוּ</he> that the priests might not slip.
B. Mets. VI, 3 אם הֶחֱלִיקָה if the animal injured herself by slipping.—4) to be smooth.
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b:4">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>בשרו מַחֲלִיק</he> his flesh is smooth.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 47b:8">B. Kam. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הוּחְלְקָה בהן</he> the animal was injured by tripping over the fruits.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 103b:11">B. Mets. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>קנים המ׳</he> smoothed (peeled) poles.—[

senses.gloss: to divide, distribute, part. Y. Keth. II, beg. 26ᵃ בוא וחַלֵּק וכ׳ come and divide with me &c. Y. Peah VIII, 20ᶜ top; Y. Shebi. VI, beg. 36ᵇ שבע שחִילְּקוּ the seven years during which they distributed the land (among the tribes); Zeb. 118ᵇ.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:7">B. Bath. IX, 7</cite> <he>המְחַלֵּק נכסיו וכ׳</he> if one disposes (wills) … by word of mouth; a. fr.—
Sabb. 70ᵃ, a. e. לחַלֵּק, v. הַבְעָרָה.—[Arakh. II, 3 (10ᵃ), v. supra.]—Part. pass. מְחוּלָּק
Yalk. Ex. 249 (ref. to אחלק, Ex. XV, 9) מ׳ אני להם I shall be divided up among them, v. Nif.; Mekh. B’shall., Shirah, s. 7 מוחלק.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: distinct, separate. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 6 והן מְחוּלָּקִין זה מזה and they are different from one another (in the range of their intellects).
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be divided, distributed; to part, separate.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 3:11">Par. III, 11</cite> <he>היה מִתְחַלֵּק וכ׳</he> was distributed among &c.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 34a">Snh. 34ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00751"><he>נִיצוֹץ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 132:1">Sifré Num. 132</cite> <he>ליוצאי מצרים נִתְחַלְּקָה וכ׳</he> the land was divided up according to the census taken at their going out from Egypt.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 132:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נתח׳ … לכל שנט וכ׳</he> the land was allotted to each tribe (in a lump), according to its population.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 132:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לא נתח׳ … אלא בשמיון</he> it was divided according to value; <cite ref="Bava Batra 122a">B. Bath. 122ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נ׳ אלא בכסף</he>.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 2</cite> <he>היה מתח׳ מחיילותיו</he> he separated himself from his armies (for prayer).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:7">Ib.</cite> <he>וכשהיה המחנה שלו מתח׳</he> and because his camp was thus divided (some praying, others not praying); a. fr.
